Claim: The "exp" claim is required in every JSON Web Token.
Quoted section (RFC 7519, 4.1.4): The "exp" (expiration time) claim identifies the expiration time on or after which the JWT MUST NOT be accepted for processing. ... Use of this claim is OPTIONAL.

verdict.instructions: Does the quoted section support the claim?

criteria.supports: The section states or directly implies the claim
criteria.contradicts: The section says the opposite of the claim
criteria.unsupported: The section does not address the claim
